fato_historico: 2001: NASA's Galileo spacecraft passes within 112 miles (180 km) of Jupiter's moon Io.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a sense of cosmic discovery, much like a daring spacecraft nearing a mysterious moon. It is a good time to explore the depths of your own brilliance and orbit your personal goals with confidence. Consider how your inner light can illuminate even the most distant corners of your path as you move forward today.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light guides you through the vast wonders of the universe.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of your own powerful intuition and inner strength.
conselho: Trust your bold spirit and embrace the new adventures waiting for you today.
